sourceSentences: Crippling Strike basic attack resets Darius' basic attack timer.
The attack's animation can be cancelled by casting Decimate, but the attack will still land.
When Darius kills a champion with Noxian Guillotine, or applies 5 stacks on an enemy champion, he becomes empowered with Noxian Might for 5 seconds.
Noxian Might: Darius gains bonus attack damage and instantly applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks through his usual means.
Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.
Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of Hemorrhage.
Darius becomes ghosted for 1 second and hefts his axe for 0.75 seconds, afterward swinging it around himself
Darius can move during Decimate, but is unable to declare basic attacks or cast Apprehend or Noxian Guillotine.
Darius is unable to move or cast Decimate or Noxian Guillotine for 0.4 seconds after Apprehend's cast time.
This leap can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, Darius will still hit the target.
He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.
At rank 3, Noxian Guillotine has no mana cost and recast timer.
If this attack kills the target, half of Crippling Strike's cooldown is reduced and its mana cost is refunded.
Spell shields will negate all effects of Crippling Strike, including the damage of the basic attack itself.
Now what you need to understand is that W is an auto- reset attack ability.
The next module or technique we will look at is the WQ animation cancellation.
If you use WQ normally without this cancellation, it looks like this. That's it. But if you do it with cancellation, it's much faster.
You might think you need to flash first and then Q, but the correct way to do it is Q first and then flash. You basically want to do a flash just as Darius is about to hit with his Q.
If you use a flash, yeah, and then a Q, it's essentially giving him more time to react to your Q.
So what you do is first press the ult and then flash. Thus, Darius will launch his ultimate as soon as he himself comes within range.
So EQ, wait, and once Q starts winding up, then you move to aim.
A player with a higher ELO will always want to be in your inner Q zone.
Enemies hit by the outer edge are dealt more damage and applied a stack of bleed. Where enemies hit by the inner part take less damage and don't get a stack of his passive.
While empowered, he gains an insane amount of attack damage and instantly applies five bleed stacks to anyone he attacks.
For combos, start with an auto attack into W and then your Q. Follow up with an attack into E before attacking into your alt.
And if you start with E, auto attack into W. Follow up with Q into two attacks into your alt.
If this kills the target, half the cool down is refunded and the mana cost.
If this kills the target, Darius fears nearby minions and monsters and also we can recast the ability within the next 20 seconds.
